item.text:
**Bottom line:** No. I found no credible 2024 evidence that Khamenei strengthened courts, legislatures, audit bodies, local governments, or oversight institutions so they could constrain him. The 2024 record instead shows continued veto/disqualification power, tight legislative control, and no meaningful empowerment of bodies that could check the ruler.

|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iran bans ex-president Rouhani from running for elite assembly | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-01-24 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-bans-ex-president-rouhani-from-running-for-elite-assembly/1937211/ | The Guardian Council barred Hassan Rouhani from the Assembly of Experts, which can supervise and dismiss the supreme leader. That is evidence against strengthening an oversight body that could constrain Khamenei. | 4B.4, 4B.1, 4B.2 |
| Iran’s rulers seek big turnout in election amid mounting discontent | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-01 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-rulers-seek-big-turnout-in-election-amid-mounting-discontent/1984836/ | Reuters framed the parliamentary vote as a legitimacy test under restrictions on political and social freedoms, not as a move to make the legislature more independent. | 4B.4, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.3 |
| Factbox-Iran’s presidential election process | Reuters via KELO-AM | 2024-06-25 | https://kelo.com/2024/06/25/factbox-irans-presidential-election-process/ | The Guardian Council cleared only five hardliners and one low-key moderate from 80 applicants; the Council is half appointed by the supreme leader and half through the judiciary chief he names. This shows continuing rule by vetted loyalists, not stronger independent institutions. | 4B.4, 4B.1, 4B.2 |
| Iran: New Hijab Law Adds Restrictions and Punishments | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-14 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/14/iran-new-hijab-law-adds-restrictions-and-punishments | Parliament delegated drafting to its smaller Judicial and Legal Commission, which limits open debate and does not reflect the whole legislature. The law advanced despite the president’s opposition, which cuts against any claim of institutional empowerment. | 4B.4, 4B.2, 4B.3 |
| Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/ | Amnesty says the judiciary drafted the law, the Guardian Council approved it, and parliament announced it would take effect. It expands enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij rather than oversight power. | 4B.4, 4B.2, 4B.3 |

Search gap: I did not find any reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei empowering audit bodies, local governments, or genuinely independent courts or legislatures against his own preferences. The available 2024 material points the other way, toward continued subordination and tighter control.
